messages:
marie_docs: Opening a small docs PR to add an "edge-cases" appendix to the Dedicated provisioning guide. Contains: short YAML quickstart, Terraform label mapping, tiny SDK examples (Java + C#), and a short runbook for migrations. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1622

eddie_sdk: Nice. Can you paste the Java + C# snippets here so I can check naming and casing? We're standardizing on snake_case for REST examples.

marie_docs: Java draft (very compact):
```java
// Java: create reserved pool (simplified)
DedicatedClient client = new DedicatedClient(System.getenv("RWD_TOKEN"));
client.createPool(Map.of(
  "name", "edge-pool",
  "gpu", "a100-80gb",
  "autoscale", Map.of("min_replicas", 1, "max_replicas", 4, "burst", 1),
  "tenant_isolation", true
));
```

marie_docs: C# draft (tiny):
```csharp
// C#: create pool (pseudo)
var client = new DedicatedClient("$RWD");
await client.CreatePoolAsync(new CreatePoolOpts {
  Name = "edge-pool",
  Gpu = "a100-80gb",
  Autoscale = new Autoscale { MinReplicas = 1, MaxReplicas = 4, Burst = 1 },
  TenantIsolation = true
});
```

toni_infra: Quick infra nit: in the Java/C# examples prefer showing snake_case payload when demonstrating REST payloads, but language SDKs can use idiomatic casing. Add a one-line comment clarifying that.

sophie_prod: SLA wording flag: don't use "no preemption" wording. Suggest: "Reserved pools are prioritized for availability; preemption of lower-tier resources can occur during capacity emergencies per SLA matrix." Link to updated matrix: https://confluence.redwood.ai/sla-matrix/v4

marie_docs: Will update phrasing. Also adding Terraform one-liner for label mapping:
```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "edge" {
  name = "edge-pool"
  gpu  = "a100-80gb"
  tenant_isolation = true
  labels = { migrated_from = "legacy-service-x" }
}
```

eddie_sdk: For SDK examples please include a single-line error handling note: migrations can return 202 + job id. Also remind readers that toggling tenant_isolation triggers reconcile/rolling restarts.

marie_docs: Adding note. Also debating a short troubleshooting runbook (4 bullets). Draft: 
- dry-run migration (`--dry-run`)
- confirm `reserved_pool_capacity` >= expected qps
- schedule maintenance window + notify consumers
- post-migration smoke test (latency + correctness)
toni_infra: Add one more: check `redwoodctl pool describe` for NodeAffinity errors (SKU not available in region). We've seen EU region gap.

marie_docs: Good call  adding it. Also including a tiny YAML quickstart sample (keeps fields minimal):
```yaml
name: edge-pool
gpu: a100-80gb
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 1
  max_replicas: 4
  burst: 1
tenant_isolation: true
```

sophie_prod: Cost note: add one-line ballpark and mark clearly as "rough estimate" linking to pricing. Example: "Rough estimate: 1 replica ≈ $Y/hr (varies by region/SKU)." Keep it non-actionable.

marie_docs: Will add single-line cost hint. Also adding short wording about tenant isolation: "tenant isolation reduces noisy-neighbor impact but does not imply dedicated physical hardware unless explicitly contracted."

eddie_sdk: Small request: include a C# comment showing `--dry-run` CLI example for migration so ops see both docs + CLI parity.

marie_docs: Adding CLI example: `redwoodctl tenant migrate --from legacy-service-x --to-pool edge-pool --dry-run`

migrate-bot: migration-check: dry-run recommended. No active migrations detected.

preview-bot: preview site built for PR #1622: https://deploy-preview.redwood.dev/docs/dedicated/edge-cases/1622 

toni_infra: One last check: avoid phrasing like "hardware isolation guaranteed" anywhere. Use "contracted hardware guarantees" where appropriate. I'll add an inline review on the PR.

marie_docs: Thanks all  I'll incorporate edits (SLA phrasing, link updates to v4, one-line cost hint, extra troubleshooting bullet) and request reviews from @toni_infra and @eddie_sdk. Target merge: EOD next Monday if no blockers.
